 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Compare the two equal-width panels around the separator.

    Cells with the same non-background symbol in both panels are marked 3;
    all other output cells use the common panel background when possible.
    """
    h = len(grid)
    if not h:
        return []
    w = len(grid[0])
    # The unique full-height divider separates two panels.
    dividers = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                and all(grid[r][c] in (2, 9) for r in range(h))]
    sep = dividers[0] if dividers else w // 2
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    # Infer panel backgrounds as their most frequent colors, ignoring the
    # sparse foreground pattern.
    from collections import Counter
    lb = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg = rb if rb == lb else next((x for x in (lb, rb) if x == 8), rb)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(n):
            if left[r][c] != lb and right[r][c] != rb and left[r][c] == right[r][c]:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
"
}
